title: Fungal Isolation and Cell DNA Extraction from Soil Samples
author: Nuttapon Pombubpa
materials: Illustrated Genera of Imperfect Fungi, Fourth Edition SEA-ARMi,
Wash columns with Solutions RA and RW.

steps.title: Prepare soil serial dilutions
steps.instruction: Using sterile water, make serial dilutions of the soil sample from 10⁻³ to 10⁻⁶ by adding 9 mL sterile water to each dilution tube.

steps.title: Plate dilutions on selective media
steps.instruction: Spread 100 µL of each dilution onto PDA and MEA plates that contain tetracycline at 40 mg/L.

steps.title: Incubate plates for fungal growth
steps.instruction: Incubate the inoculated plates at room temperature (25–30 °C) for 5–7 days until fungal colonies become visible.

steps.title: Transfer hyphae to fresh PDA
steps.instruction: From mixed colonies, transfer fungal hyphae onto fresh PDA plates to begin purification.

steps.title: Incubate purified plates until pure
steps.instruction: Incubate the transferred plates at 25–30 °C for 5–7 days; repeat transfers and incubations until a single, pure culture is obtained.

steps.title: Document colony morphology and microscopy
steps.instruction: Record colony macroscopic features (color, margin, elevation, texture, zonation, radial furrow, exudate) and prepare slide cultures to observe hyphal and spore structures; stain slides with lactophenol‑cotton blue for better visualization.

substeps.instruction: Prepare slide cultures using the slide culture technique.
Add lactophenol‑cotton blue stain to the growth on the slide.
Observe and note hyphal septation, spore types (macro‑, micro‑conidia, chlamydospores, etc.), sporangiophore, and conidiophore characteristics.

steps.title: Confirm fungal identity with references
steps.instruction: Compare the recorded colony and microscopic characteristics with the descriptions in Barnett & Hunter (1998) and the SEA‑ARMi 2025 WHO‑FPPL targeted filamentous fungi list.

steps.title: Extract DNA using AllPrep kit
steps.instruction: Use the AllPrep Fungal DNA Kit to isolate DNA from the purified hyphae following the kit protocol.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend harvested fungal cells in Solution HC.
Perform cell lysis by vortexing the suspension.
Load the lysate onto the MB spin columns.

steps.title: Verify DNA quality by agarose gel
steps.instruction: Run an aliquot of the extracted DNA on an agarose gel to assess integrity and purity.

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Nanodrop
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity on a Nanodrop spectrophotometer; ensure the concentration is ≥10 ng/µL.

steps.title: Ship DNA to analysis team
steps.instruction: Send the purified fungal DNA to the FAILSAFE Project Team, SEA‑ARMi at Chulalongkorn University for further analysis.

steps.title: Set up ITS PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µL PCR mixture for ITS region amplification using the following components:

substeps.instruction: 12.5 µL PCR master mix containing Taq DNA polymerase.
12 µL DNA template solution diluted with molecular‑grade water to a final DNA amount of 100 ng.
Prepare a negative control lacking DNA template and a positive control using DNA from an identified fungal strain.

steps.title: Run PCR thermocycling program
steps.instruction: Thermocycle the ITS PCR as follows: initial denaturation at 95 °C for 5 min; 25 cycles of 95 °C for 1 min, 56 °C for 25 s, 72 °C for 30 s; final extension at 72 °C for 5 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Analyze PCR product by agarose gel
steps.instruction: Separate the PCR products on a 1.5 % agarose gel containing a 1 kb DNA ladder as a size marker, running at 100 V for 22 min in 1× TBE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 1.5 % agarose gel in 1× TBE.
Load 5 µL of each PCR product together with the 1 kb ladder.
Run the gel at 100 V for 22 min.

steps.title: Submit PCR product for Sanger sequencing
steps.instruction: Send high‑quality PCR amplicons for Sanger sequencing; upon receipt, identify the sequences by BLAST search against the NCBI database.

steps.title: Grow hyphae in PDB broth
steps.instruction: Inoculate the pure fungal colony into potato dextrose broth (PDB) and incubate for 5 days at 25–30 °C with shaking at 100 rpm to obtain sufficient hyphal biomass.
